scenario run(values:int[]) by=members
 do
  for in in values limit=1
   let value=in
derive names(values:Item[]):Item[] = values as where where where.active

derive match(value:Item):bool = value.return and true
derive active(value:Item):bool = value.where or false
derive names(value:Item[]):Item[] = value.select as item select item

crud Item by=members fields=title
 examples create
  title -> result.title
  "One" -> "One"
 examples update record=first_item
  changes.title -> first_item.title
  "Two" -> "Two"
 examples delete record=first_item
  as -> first_item.archived_at!=null
  members -> true

migration Example from="installed"
 rename before.Task.title to Task.name
 drop before.Task.legacy
 invalidate before.tick
 backfill Task
  do set row {name=before.title}
derive rows():Item[] = make() as item where item.active

derive check():bool = all() and true
derive check2():bool = any() or false

derive names():text[] = (Item
 as item
 where item.active
 order=-item.created
 select item.title
)

list list as item columns=name
form form
action action
for return in values limit=1
 let chosen=return
